items.title: 21.13 Samandari gardish mein namak aur density ka kirdar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of salt and density in ocean circulation (PDF 182).

blocks.text: Samandar ke pani mein mukhtalif ghule maddey hain, sab se zyada namak. Samandar ke pani mein namak ki miqdar us ka namkeenpan (salinity) kehlati hai. Zyada namak wala pani bhari, yani ghana, hota hai, kyunke ghula namak hajm ko khaas barhaye baghair pani ki kamiyat barhata hai. Yun zyada namkeenpan zyada density deta hai.

Samandar mein pani ke hisson ke darmiyan density ke farq gardish chalane wali kaleedi quwwaton mein se hain, khaas taur par gehre paniyon mein. Yeh zyada tar darja hararat aur namkeenpan ke farq se paida hote hain: thanda pani garam se ghana, aur namkeen pani kam namkeen se ghana hai. Jab satah ka pani zyada thanda aur namkeen ho jata hai, aksar bukharat (evaporation) ya samandari barf banne se, to woh ghana ho kar gehri tahon mein doob jata hai. Ghana pani doobte hue doosre pani ko hata deta hai, jis se dheemi lekin bare paimane ki dhaarein banti hain jo duniya ke samandaron mein gardish karti hain. Yeh gehri gardish hararat aur oxygen aur carbon dioxide jaisi gases duniya bhar mein le jati, satah aur gehre pani ko jorti, aur zameen ke mausam ko qaboo karne mein nazuk kirdar ada karti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Bahr-e-Murdar (Dead Sea) itna namkeen hai ke log is mein be-mehnat tairte hain: namak ki ziyadti ki wajah se is ke pani ki density bohat zyada hai.

blocks.prompt: Qutbi ilaqon mein barf bante hue samandar ka pani zyada namkeen ho jata hai. Yeh samandari gardish par kya asar karta hai, aur kaun sa amal chalata hai?
blocks.explanation: Samandari barf bante waqt zyada tar namak peeche chhor deti hai, is liye baqi pani zyada thanda aur namkeen, yani ghana, hota hai; yeh doob kar thermohaline gardish (global conveyor belt) ka gehra hissa chalata hai.

items: Salinity: ghula namak; zyada namak, ghana pani.
Thanda, namkeen pani doobta; density ke farq gehri samandari gardish chalate, hararat aur gases le jate.
